Mount view Park,6th Filing from LR Low-density Residential toMURMixed-use Residential Emphasis.The
subject property is currently vacant and was historically a church.The proposed zone change is due to a
proposal toconvert the existing structure into a real estate office.
The current zoning designation of LR does not permi the use of Office-General.The adjacent office uses
and the surrounding residential properties illustrate that the MuR District is the best fit for proposed use
for the subject property.The MuR District will permi the use of real estate office through an
residential use if it should ever redevelop again.
The current Future Land Use designation of the subject property is Public/Quasi-Public.This designation
describes potential uses as usesrelated to community services, such as fire stations, schools, libraries,
places of worship within the City have this future land use designation; however, the Public/Quasi-Public
designation does not consider waysin which these properties may redevelop.Dueto this requested zone

have a Mixed-use Residential designation North of Lincolnway and a Mixed-Use Commercial Designation
South of Lincolnway.This Future Land Use Map Amendment is accompanying this zone change througha
separate Resolution.
Due to meeting the review criteria of Section2.2.1.d of the Cheyenne Unified Development
Code, staff recommends approval of this zone change; contingent on the approval of the
Future Land Use Map Amendment for the area.
